samplingRule: Sort canonical arXiv IDs ascending; random.Random(seed).sample(population, devSize+testSize); first devSize to dev, remaining to sealed test. No resampling based on titles, labels, predictions or availability.
scope: Finite metadata listing snapshot: cs.AI February 2025 after canonical historical exposure exclusion. Not all arXiv, all AI or all DBLP; metadata isolation alone is not proof of semantic independence.
